name: Revel
overview: The topic of 'Revel' centers on God's divine disclosure of future events and His invitation to draw near to Him in faith and purity. Revelation 1:1 emphasizes that God revealed to Jesus Christ the things that must soon come to pass, communicated through an angel to John, underscoring the certainty and authority of this prophetic message. This divine revelation calls believers to a response of repentance and closeness to God, as James 4:8 urges drawing near to God with cleansed hearts. The promise of salvation and eternal life through faith in Christ, highlighted in John 3:16, complements this call, while Psalms 80:19 and Luke 1:37 affirm that God's turning toward His people brings salvation and that nothing is impossible with Him. Together, these verses reveal a God who reveals His plans to encourage trust, holiness, and hope in His redemptive power.
